widget.instructions: Drag a vector's tip, or select it and type its size and direction in Precise controls.

stem: Two displacements of {{a}} m and {{b}} m are made with an angle of {{th}}° between their directions.
What is the magnitude of the resultant displacement, in metres?

hints.text: The amber arrow on the board is a + b: watch it as you think.
Use the law for any angle: R² = a² + b² + 2ab cos θ.

perpendicular-formula-misapplied.text: √(a² + b²) holds only for vectors at right angles. Include the 2ab cos θ term.

cosine-law-sign.text: With θ as the angle between the two vectors (tail to tail), the term is +2ab cos θ.

workedSolution.text: R = {{ans}} m, at {{dir}}° to the first displacement.

perpendicular-formula-misapplied.front: Resultant of a and b at angle θ?
perpendicular-formula-misapplied.back: R = √(a² + b² + 2ab cos θ); √(a² + b²) only when θ = 90°.

cosine-law-sign.front: Sign of 2ab cos θ in the resultant formula?
cosine-law-sign.back: Plus, when θ is the angle between a and b placed tail to tail.

generic.front: Resultant of a and b at angle θ?

accessibility.altText: Two vectors on a grid at {{th}}° to each other, with their resultant.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Select an arrow and type its size and direction in Precise controls; type your answer in the box.
